name: environment-and-planning
description: Finnish environmental and planning law: environmental permits and supervision (ympäristönsuojelulaki 527/2014), land use planning and construction under the new Building Act (rakentamislaki 751/2023) and the Land Use Act, and environmental liabilities in transactions. Takes account of the 2026 reform of regional administration (Lupa- ja valvontavirasto).

interface.longDescription: Finnish environmental and planning law under the reformed legislation: environmental permits and supervision (YSL 527/2014), land use planning and building (the Land Use Act and the Building Act 751/2023 with their new permits), and environmental liabilities and environmental due diligence in transactions. Takes account of the 2026 authority reform (the Finnish Licensing and Supervision Agency).
